exact_statement:
theorem critical_no_infinite :
    (∀ᵐ ω ∂bondLaw bondCritical, ∀ x : Vertex, (bondCluster ω x).Finite) ∧
    (∀ᵐ ω ∂siteLaw siteCritical, ∀ x : Vertex, (siteCluster ω x).Finite)
